mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT organization.organization_unit_id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, parent.organization_name AS parent_organization_name, organization.root_unit, organization.active, organization.version_no FROM visible_scope scope JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = scope.organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.organization_unit parent ON parent.organization_unit_id = organization.parent_id ORDER BY organization.root_unit DESC, organization.organization_code

SELECT organization.organization_unit_id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, organization.parent_id, parent.organization_name AS parent_organization_name, organization.root_unit, organization.active, organization.version_no FROM visible_scope scope JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = scope.organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN seal.organization_unit parent ON parent.organization_unit_id = organization.parent_id WHERE organization.organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope WHERE organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.organization_unit (organization_unit_id, organization_code, organization_name, parent_id, root_unit, active) VALUES (#{organizationUnitId}, #{organizationCode}, #{organizationName}, #{parentId}, FALSE, TRUE)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT organization_unit_id, parent_id FROM seal.organization_unit WHERE organization_unit_id = #{parentId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.organization_unit_id, parent.parent_id FROM seal.organization_unit parent JOIN ancestors child ON parent.organization_unit_id = child.parent_id ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId})

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM seal.organization_unit WHERE parent_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND active = TRUE) + (SELECT count(*) FROM seal.admin_user WHERE organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND account_status <> 'INACTIVE') + (SELECT count(*) FROM seal.retention_policy WHERE owner_organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND policy_status = 'ACTIVE') + (SELECT count(*) FROM seal.processing_activity WHERE owner_organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND activity_status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.organization_unit SET organization_name = #{organizationName}, parent_id = #{parentId, jdbcType=OTHER}, active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}
